bugs.summary: The conditional-include hook is named include_website_name without the ?, so ActiveModel::Serializers never calls it and website_name is always serialized, as null when the user has no website.
bugs.evidence: user_serializer.rb:153 `def include_website_name`; the serializer's other conditional hooks and AMS 0.8 use `include_<attr>?`. Golden comment (Martian discourse.json).

bugs.summary: website_name is a plain attribute, not an untrusted one, so for a TL0 user viewed anonymously (where website is hidden to deter spam) the serializer still exposes the website's host and path via website_name, and the profile renders the globe and link text.
bugs.evidence: user_serializer.rb:24-33 untrusted_attributes defines include_<attr>? returning false when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object); :105-111 lists :website but not :website_name; :43 adds :website_name to plain attributes and :153-155 `def include_website_name; website.present?; end` (never called, and even as include_website_name? it would not check restriction). lib/guardian/user_guardian.rb:58-60 restrict_user_fields? = TL0 && anonymous. user.hbs now shows {{model.website_name}} when present.

rejected.why: A mixed-case website host only falls back to showing the bare host instead of host+path; display choice, no wrong or lost data.

rejected.was: cluster: "." << website_host mutates a string literal (00,06,08,12,22,23,24)
rejected.why: Without frozen_string_literal the literal is a fresh String on each call; mutation is harmless.

rejected.was: cluster: root path yields a trailing slash (06,07,13,21,23,24)
cluster: scheme-less website loses its display name (18,21,22)
rejected.why: Not a regression: the removed client code `website.split("/")[2]` also returned nothing for a scheme-less value.

rejected.was: cluster: URI parsed repeatedly / rescue swallows errors (06,08,12,22,24)
rejected.why: Style; rescue nil is the intended fallback to no display name.

rejected.was: cluster: www vs apex and sibling-subdomain matching (00,07,19,22)
rejected.why: Matches the commented intent of each branch (user_serializer.rb:142-149); product choice, not a code defect.

rejected.was: port, query and fragment dropped from display name
rejected.why: Display text only; the href still uses the full website.

rejected.was: same-depth heuristic matches unrelated hosts under multi-part TLDs (foo.co.uk vs bar.co.uk) or single-label website hosts
rejected.why: Only changes whether the display text includes the path, which is public in the href anyway; cosmetic.

rejected.was: removed websiteName computed may still be referenced elsewhere
rejected.why: At head no template or controller references websiteName (user.hbs switched to model.website_name; user-card has no website).

rejected.was: v-every-instance-high: include_website_name overrides generated trust-gating include_website_name?
rejected.why: Wrong mechanism (website_name is not in untrusted_attributes), but its consequence, website_name served to restricted viewers, is b2; counted as matching b2.
